title.zh: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids
title.en: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids

current_state.zh: Eight US states — Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho, and Montana — filed separate lawsuits against OpenAI, alleging it harmed children and misled customers about ChatGPT's safety.
